Research
5 Ways AI Feedback Boosts Student Outcomes
GradeAnt Editorial
Mar 14, 2026 · 4 min read
When feedback arrives the same day, students are far more likely to act on it. After analyzing 312,000 graded papers, three patterns stood out clearly.
1. Timeliness beats length
"Students who got feedback within 24 hours revised their work 3× more often."
2. Specificity drives revision
Grade your next batch in seconds.
